 !

--- running

  rule 5 permit tcp destination-port eq 443

 interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
diffs.core:
--- running
+++ candidate
@@ -6,7 +6,13 @@
 interface GigabitEthernet0/0
  description UPLINK
+ ip access-group FIX-Gi0-0-IN in
 !
 router ospf 1
  network 10.0.0.0 0.0.255.255 area 0
 !
+ip access-list extended FIX-Gi0-0-IN
+ 10 deny tcp any any eq 23
+ 20 deny tcp any any eq 445

+!

result.explanation:
site-a (IOS): adds deny tcp/445; deny telnet already present, HTTPS stays permitted via permit ip any.
site-b (VRP): adds deny tcp/23; deny 445 + permit 443 already present.
core (IOS): new ACL FIX-Gi0-0-IN inbound on Gi0/0: deny 23, deny 445, permit ip any any.
NOT touched: all other interfaces/filters unchanged; ssh/dns/http/ntp/snmp/bgp/https/rdp/ping identical.
Risk: MEDIUM – new inbound filter bound to core Gi0/0.

reasons: core: new inbound filter bound to GigabitEthernet0/0
